answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can trade, and tie that stake to a verifiable work history. A hollow identity with no past transactions and no locked stake cannot mirror a real trader reputation, because reputation is earned through settled deals, not claimed. Anyone can invent a fable of a thousand fake personas, but each one must pay the same stake and build the same history, so the attack cost scales with its size while honest agents pay once and keep trading.
